title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 27
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 27: leviathan punished, the pleasant vineyard kept by Yahweh, and Israel gathered at the great trumpet.

questions.text: Whom will Yahweh punish with his hard and great and strong sword in that day?
questions.explanation: In that day Yahweh will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan the twisted serpent, and kill the dragon in the sea.

answers.text: The army of the high ones

questions.text: How does Yahweh care for the pleasant vineyard?
questions.explanation: Yahweh is its keeper; he waters it every moment and keeps it night and day, lest anyone damage it.

answers.text: He waters it every moment and keeps it night and day
He builds a high watchtower in the middle of it
He hedges it about with briers and thorns
He hires workers to prune and dress its vines

questions.text: What would Yahweh do if he found briers and thorns?
questions.explanation: He says that if he should find briers and thorns, he would do battle, march on them, and burn them together.

answers.text: Pull them up by the roots
March on them and burn them together

questions.text: What should a person take hold of in order to make peace with Yahweh?
questions.explanation: The alternative offered is: "let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me."

questions.text: What will Israel do in days to come?
questions.explanation: In days to come Jacob will take root, Israel will blossom and bud, and they will fill the surface of the world with fruit.

answers.text: Blossom and bud, and fill the world with fruit

questions.text: What will happen to the stones of the altar when Jacob's iniquity is forgiven?
questions.explanation: The fruit of taking away his sin is that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones beaten in pieces, so the Asherah poles and incense altars rise no more.

answers.text: They will be carried off to Assyria
They will be rebuilt in Jerusalem
They will be made as chalk stones beaten in pieces
They will be washed in the river

questions.text: Which animal will feed and lie down in the solitary fortified city?
questions.explanation: The fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted like the wilderness; the calf will feed there and lie down.

questions.text: Who will come and set the withered boughs on fire?
questions.explanation: When its boughs are withered and broken off, the women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people of no understanding.

questions.text: Between which two places will Yahweh thresh in that day?
questions.explanation: Yahweh will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt, and the children of Israel will be gathered one by one.

answers.text: From the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt
From Dan even as far as Beersheba
From Lebanon to the shore of the sea
From Mount Zion to the city of Bozrah

questions.text: What will be blown in that day when the outcasts come to worship at Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: In that day a great trumpet will be blown, and those perishing in Assyria and the outcasts in Egypt will come and worship Yahweh in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.

answers.text: A ram's horn by the priests
A watchman's horn on the wall
